note: Maintained community language-pack catalog. Entries point at versioned GitHub release assets (.lpk archives built with `langpack build`). The app fetches this file from the URL configured in LTS_PACK_CATALOG_URL, verifies every entry (https + GitHub release hosts only, pinned SHA-256, pinned size), and installs through the same validation gate as bundled packs. Add an entry only after `langpack test <pack>` passes and licenses/provenance records are complete. review_status is the author's claim ('community' or 'reviewed'); the app never upgrades it to verified trust. Platform status is three-way and never inferred from a successful build: see platform_note.
platform_note: Three-way platform status (ADR-0015, docs/13 PLAT-001): tested_platforms is maintainer/owner-run runtime evidence (Linux only today); community_confirmed_platforms comes only from human runtime reports in docs/platform/PLATFORM_REPORTS.yaml bound to the exact app build and archive sha256; everything else is untested. Downloads for untested platforms may exist, but they are labeled untested. Any rebuild of the app or the pack invalidates a confirmation.
